blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Tuesday approved on second reading a bill that would institutionalize a 30-year national infrastructure master plan to ensure projects are implemented consistently, regardless of political changes. Lawmakers approved House Bill No. 11597, or the Masterplan for Infrastructure and National Development (MIND) Act, by voice vote. Designed as a long-term roadmap for public works, the measure directs the government to craft a comprehensive infrastructure vision updated every six years, while allowing earlier reviews if technological advances, crises or economic disruptions require them. “This measure recognizes a simple but important principle.
